prompt.en: Unlike classical Pentecostalism, which formed new denominations, the Charismatic Renewal spread within the ____ denominations.

prompt.en: The second wave is commonly dated to 1960, when Dennis Bennett, rector of the ____ parish in Van Nuys, California, told his congregation he had spoken in tongues.

prompt.en: Besides the Charismatic Renewal, the second wave was sometimes called ____: the same experience flowing through the historic denominations.
prompt.es: Además de Renovación Carismática, la segunda ola a veces se llamó ____: la misma experiencia fluyendo por las denominaciones históricas.

prompt.es: La Renovación Carismática Católica se rastrea usualmente a un retiro de 1967 al que asistieron estudiantes y profesores de la Universidad de ____ en Pittsburgh.

prompt.en: The best-known expression of the third wave was the ____ movement, led by John Wimber.
prompt.es: La expresión más conocida de la tercera ola fue el movimiento de la ____, dirigido por John Wimber.

prompt.en: By the end of the twentieth century the movement had become, above all, a phenomenon of the ____.

prompt.en: Across all these movements the one constant test is whether the work exalts ____ and makes His people more like Him.
